q7_rca2a1_proposal_relevance.basis: the Strict+CompactTyped unified envelope freezes per-kind status enums at the resolver with the SAME accepted values; schema narrowing does not change the value vocabulary the model must produce

the unified envelope still names the status field to_status; whether the model would abbreviate it again cannot be established from one sample
